rows.definition: The debt integer emitted by the negframe scorecard (internal/negframe DebtKey "negframe_debt"): the count of mechanical negative-frame steer-prose defects with a positive reframe attached, folded from the document corpus.
rows.distinction: ONE scorecard's debt integer (negframe steer-prose defects) - NOT total-debt (the portfolio sum across all scorecards) and NOT disambiguation-debt (this scorecard's own naming-clarity debt).

rows.definition: The debt integer emitted by the qa-process scorecard (internal/qaprocessscore DebtKey "qa_process_debt"): HARD gaps in the test process - reverted landings with no regression test, packages below coverage floor - that are in-tree-mendable holes, not failing tests.
rows.distinction: ONE scorecard's debt integer (test-process gaps) - NOT skip-debt (the SOFT skip-line rule that feeds it as one KPI input) and NOT total-debt (the portfolio sum).

rows.definition: The boundarylint.SkipDebt rule (Code "SKIP_DEBT") that flags a test removing itself from the suite with a bare, unconditional t.Skip - a SOFT signal feeding the qa-process scorecard's skip_debt KPI, never a gate.
rows.distinction: A SOFT RULE / finding-class (one KPI input to qa_process_debt) - NOT qa_process_debt itself (the folded integer it feeds) and NOT a scorecard subsystem.

rows.definition: The standard scorecard payload field (json "debt_by_kpi"): a map[string]int breaking one scorecard's total debt down by its KPI names (lint, tests, structure, ...), emitted by every scorecard's corpus fold.
rows.distinction: The per-KPI BREAKDOWN map (one scorecard's debt split by axis) - NOT total-debt (the single summed integer across all scorecards) and NOT a single scorecard's *_debt DebtKey constant (the headline integer this map decomposes).

rows.definition: The trend int field (DebtDelta / json "debt_delta") on cadencereport and milestoneburndown Trend structs: the signed change in a scorecard's debt between two cadence snapshots, and the docfreshrsi score component measuring rewrite paydown.
rows.distinction: The SIGNED TREND DELTA between two snapshots - NOT total-debt (the absolute at one point in time) and NOT grade-debt (the severity-weighted variant of the same fold).

rows.definition: The HARD-gate debt integer emitted by the agent-readiness scorecard (friction_debt): the count of concrete cold-agent friction defects - missing entry points, dead orientation links, no copy-pasteable first command - that block an AI agent from adopting fak.
rows.distinction: ONE scorecard's debt integer (agent friction) - NOT total-debt (the portfolio sum) and NOT disambiguation-debt (this scorecard's own naming-clarity debt).

rows.definition: The debt integer emitted by the seo/aeo scorecard (internal/seoaeoscore Corpus.SEODebt / json "seo_debt"): the total count of discoverability defects across pages and site-level checks (meta, links, JSON-LD, sitemap, crawlability).
rows.distinction: ONE scorecard's debt integer (search/answer-engine discoverability) - NOT total-debt (the portfolio sum) and NOT disambiguation-debt (this scorecard's own naming-clarity debt).

rows.definition: The debt integer emitted by the mode-debt scorer/dispatcher pair (internal/modedebt DebtKey "mode_debt"): HARD un-lifted permission-regime dials - operator-facing mode switches that lack a dogfood witness or a documented lift path.
rows.distinction: ONE scorecard's debt integer (permission-mode dials) - NOT total-debt (the portfolio sum) and NOT disambiguation-debt (this scorecard's own naming-clarity debt).

rows.definition: The milestonereport.ProgramScorecard struct (attached via WithProgramScorecard): one program-optimization card (e.g. kernel-optimization, cache-optimization) pinned to a milestone with a verdict (not-yet / lovable / ...), composing into the milestone report alongside the climb and roadmap dimensions.
rows.distinction: A PROGRAM-level scorecard attached to a milestone report (an ongoing-optimization program like kernel/cache) - NOT the generic scorecard (a per-surface debt measurement) and NOT the control pane (the portfolio fold over all scorecards).
